visualRisks.description: Waterfront district has a narrow path between houses and the dock, which might be visually confusing or difficult to navigate.
The house at row 12 seems isolated without any direct road connection, potentially creating an unreachable area.

navigationRisks.description: Route includes a sudden change in direction and distance between points (e.g., from 42 to 88), which may confuse players.
The route has multiple consecutive turns without clear visual cues, making it difficult for players to follow the path accurately.
